newsitem.title: FRANCE: French navy sends rescue helicopters for balloon.
newsitem.headline: French navy sends rescue helicopters for balloon.

text.p: The French navy said on Sunday it was sending rescue helicopters to the aid of a two-man balloon attempting to fly around the world which is expected to ditch in the Mediterranean only six hours after takeoff in Switzerland.
"We have been alerted and are sending out rescue helicopters to the Gulf of Aiguemorte area south of Montpellier," an official at the regional rescue centre in Toulon told Reuters.
Coast Guards said the closest town on shore to the area where the balloon was expected to come down was Le-Grau-du-Roi near the estuary of the Rhone river, an area with instense cargo vessel traffic.
